_comment: Shown to models by scripts/evaluate.py. Notes document the legacy quirks the way a team's data dictionary would, without hinting at any trap. example_rows: per table, WHERE conditions whose first matching row (by id) must be among the example rows; the rest are the first rows by id.
notes: musteri and adres: rows migrated from the previous e-commerce platform (kaynak_sistem = 'ESKI_AKTARIM') store ad and soyad, and sehir and ilce, in upper case; the other rows use normal capitalization.
Prices and order amounts (urun, siparis, siparis_kalemi, iade) include KDV; kargo.kargo_maliyeti is the carrier's charge without KDV.
kargo.teslim_zamani is text in DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM format; the other date columns hold ISO dates.
iade.iade_tutari is text in Turkish number format.
